Question_Text: Are the subjects who participated and were analyzed described?
Is the age (mean, standard deviation, and range) of subjects provided?
Is the sex/gender distribution (counts or frequencies) of subjects provided?
Are the education level and/or socioeconomic status (SES) of subjects described?
Is the handedness of subjects reported?
Are the exclusion criteria for subject participation stated?
Are the clinical criteria for subject inclusion/grouping described?
Is the target population and the recruitment strategy described?
Is it stated that ethical approval was obtained (e.g., from an IRB or ethics committee)?
Is it stated that informed consent was obtained from participants?
Is the MRI scanner manufacturer and model specified?
Is the type of head coil used specified? (eg., 32-channel head coil)
Is the type of pulse sequence used described (e.g., echo-planar, spin echo, GRE, SE)?
Is the imaging type specified (e.g., fMRI, dMRI, structural)?
Are the essential sequence and imaging parameters (e.g., TR, TE, flip angle, FOV, matrix size, voxel size) reported?
Is the phase encoding direction reported?
Is the slice acquisition order (e.g., sequential, interleaved) and timing reported?
Is the extent of brain coverage described (e.g., whole-brain, partial coverage)?
Were procedures used to ensure T1 stabilization (e.g., dummy scans), and are they described?
Is the primary software package(s) used for preprocessing named?
Is the method used for brain extraction (skull stripping) described?
Is the tissue segmentation method described?
Is the method used for motion correction described?
Is the method for coregistering functional and structural images within subjects described?
Is the method used for intersubject registration (normalization to a template/atlas) described?
Is the specific data (e.g., BOLD signal, FA values, connectivity) submitted to statistical modeling clearly defined?
Is the spatial domain of the analysis specified (e.g., whole-brain, ROI-based)?
Are the independent variables (predictors, regressors) included in the statistical model clearly stated? (e.g. adding a covariate)
Is the type of statistical model used specified (e.g., GLM, mixed-effects)?
Are relevant settings or assumptions of the statistical model described?
Is the specific contrast or effect being tested clearly defined? (e.g. pre/post, across-task, rest versus active, etc.)
Is the type of statistic used for inference reported (e.g., T-statistic, F-statistic)?
Is the method for computing p-values described (e.g., parametric, permutation)?
Is the dependent variable specifically defined for the analysis method (e.g., connectivity matrix, pattern vector)?
Are the main effects or hypotheses tested clearly summarized?
Are unthresholded statistical maps made available?
Are the actual extracted data values from ROIs reported or made available?
Are relevant spatial features of the results described (e.g., cluster size, peak location)?
If used, are the specific clinical instruments used (e.g., questionnaires, scales) named?
If groups were matched, is the matching strategy described?
If neurocognitive measures are used, are they described?
Were any special accommodations made for participants during scanning described?
If conditional shimming procedures are used, are they described?
If parallel imaging was used, are the method and acceleration factor reported?
If multiband/simultaneous multi-slice imaging was used, are the parameters (e.g., acceleration factor) reported?
Was a fat suppression method used, and if so, is it described?
Was any preprocessing performed on the scanner console, and if so, is it described?
For ASL MRI, are the specific acquisition details reported?
For DSC MRI, are the specific acquisition details reported?
Was motion monitoring performed during the scan, and if so, how?
Were any post-acquisition steps taken regarding T1 stabilization effects described?
Is the method used for slice timing correction described?
If gradient distortion correction was applied, is the method described?
For dMRI, is the method used for eddy current correction described?
For dMRI, is the model or method used for diffusion estimation described (e.g., DTI, HARDI)?
For dMRI, if tractography was performed, are the algorithm and parameters described?
If susceptibility or other distortion corrections were applied, is the method described?
Were any intensity correction or normalization steps applied, and are they described?
Are methods used to remove artifacts or structured noise (e.g., physiological noise) described if calculating functional connectivity or FaLFF?
If volume censoring/scrubbing was performed, are the criteria and method described?
For rs-fMRI, is the specific feature analyzed (e.g., ALFF, ReHo, functional connectivity) defined?
Is the spatial smoothing kernel size (FWHM) and method reported?
Is the method used to correct for multiple comparisons described, including the threshold used?
If ICA was used, are the method and parameters described?
Is the specific measure or model used for functional connectivity described?
If effective connectivity was modeled, is the method described?
If graph theory analysis was performed, are the methods (node/edge definition, metrics) described?
If multivariate modeling or predictive analysis was used, is the overall approach described?
Are the methods for feature extraction and/or dimension reduction described?
Is the specific predictive model/algorithm used described (e.g., SVM, regression)?
Is the learning method described (e.g., supervised, unsupervised)?
Is the procedure for training the model described (e.g., cross-validation scheme)?
Are the evaluation metrics for discrete responses (e.g., accuracy, sensitivity, specificity) reported?
Are the evaluation metrics for continuous responses (e.g., correlation, R-squared) reported?
If RSA was performed, are the evaluation metrics reported?
If data are shared, is the specific material being shared (e.g., raw data, processed data, code) clearly stated?
If data are shared, is a URL or other specific access information provided for shared materials?
If data are shared, are statements regarding ethics compliance related to data sharing included?
If data are shared, is the format of the shared data described?
If essential for replication purposes, is information about the computational infrastructure used (if relevant) provided?
For ASL, are the specific preprocessing steps (e.g., quantification) described?
For DSC MRI, are the specific preprocessing steps (e.g., conversion to concentration) described?
